label: MVO Official Transcritical CO2 GBDT Surrogate Family
request: Optimize the MVO Official Transcritical CO2 GBDT Surrogate Family using the official IDAES-MVO transcritical CO2 process-family formulation.
scope: Original data grid and original feasible alternatives; fresh deterministic GBDT cost surrogate; discrete common-module design optimization. Not a reproduction of the archived continuous surrogate model.
